prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a busy airport gate scene with precise detail. On the left, a woman in a blue coat sits on a metal bench, her posture relaxed yet attentive as she waits. Next to her, a small child in a yellow raincoat stands holding a plush teddy bear, looking up at the woman with curiosity. In the center, a man in a gray suit checks his wristwatch, his expression focused on the time. To his right, a rolling suitcase with a bright red tag rests upright against his leg, suggesting imminent travel. Further right, an elderly person in a knitted hat points toward the departure screen, drawing the attention of a nearby teenager in a green hoodie who looks in that direction with interest. The floor is polished tile, reflecting the overhead lights softly. There is no food or drink visible in the scene, keeping the focus entirely on the travelers and their immediate surroundings. The composition balances the figures across the frame, creating a natural snapshot of transit life.
